title: Scan Repair for Foundation Models: code for 'Repair Once or Pay per Prediction? Subgroup Repair versus More Context for Tabular Foundation Models' (AccML 2027)
description: Structured Scan Repair: fast, interpretable, held-out-validated subgroup repair for fitted tabular classifiers (TabPFN-2.5, TabICLv2, XGBoost, CatBoost), with every experiment and the scripts that rebuild every table, figure and number of the AccML 2027 paper. Saved logits and results are archived separately (scan-repair-foundation-models-artistry).

creators.name: Adetunji, Kayode E.
